## Validation

List commands and real workflows exercised. Include skipped checks with reason and impact.

## Compatibility and release impact

- Version impact: none / prerelease / patch / minor / major
- Data or configuration migration: none, or describe it
- Changelog updated: yes / not required

## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff contains one coherent checkpoint.
- [ ] The title follows `type(scope): imperative summary` and is at most 72 characters.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are included.
- [ ] Generated files, local data, caches, and secrets are excluded.
- [ ] Required decisions are recorded in `docs/decisions/`.
- [ ] All discussions are resolved and approval follows the latest push.
